title: Nursing Home and Terminal Illness Waivers of Surrender Charge — Fixed Indexed Annuities
content:
**Endorsement wording — Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities**

**Waiver.** Surrender charges and bonus recapture are waived on withdrawals and on surrender:

- **(a) nursing home confinement** — where the tier includes the nursing home confinement waiver and the owner has been confined to a licensed nursing facility for at least the tier's required number of consecutive days, the confinement beginning in the tier's first waiver contract year or later; or
- **(b) terminal illness** — where the tier includes the terminal illness waiver and a physician certifies, after the first contract year, a life expectancy of the tier's certified life expectancy or less.

**Claim.** A waiver applies only under a waiver claim whose request status is approved. The claim is read from Ashgrove's service request record for that waiver claim — its request type, signed date and request status — before the withdrawal or surrender to which the waiver is applied.

### Condition table (each branch on its own)

| Branch | Tier includes the waiver | Event | Timing | Approved waiver claim |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| (a) | nursing home confinement waiver | owner confined to a licensed nursing facility at least the required consecutive days | confinement begins in the first waiver contract year or later | required |
| (b) | terminal illness waiver | physician certifies life expectancy of the required months or less | certification after the first contract year | required |

Either branch, with an approved waiver claim, waives both the surrender charge and any bonus recapture, on a partial withdrawal or on a full surrender.

### Hypothetical cases (every tier: 90 consecutive days, 12 months, first waiver contract year 2)

| Case | Facts | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Owner confined 95 consecutive days, confinement began in contract year 3, waiver claim approved | Branch (a) met; waiver applies |
| 2 | Owner confined 95 consecutive days, confinement began in contract year 1 | Branch (a) timing not met |
| 3 | Owner confined 89 consecutive days, began in contract year 4 | Branch (a) day count not met |
| 4 | Physician certifies a life expectancy of 10 months in contract year 2, waiver claim approved | Branch (b) met; waiver applies |
| 5 | Physician certifies a life expectancy of 10 months in contract year 4; waiver claim still pending, not approved | No approved waiver claim; the waiver does not apply |
| 6 | Annuitant who is not the owner is confined 120 consecutive days | Branch (a) speaks of the owner's confinement; not met on these facts |
